sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def getP1():
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(tuple(1 if lines[r][c]=='B' else 0 for c in range(22,27)) for r in range(52,57))
def show(s): return '\n'.join(''.join('#' if v else '.' for v in row) for row in s)
action(['DOWN'])  # back to c0
c0=getP1()
print("c0"); print(show(c0))
cycle=[c0]
for i in range(6):
    action(['UP'])
    s=getP1()
    cycle.append(s)
    print("c%d"% (i+1)); print(show(s))
print("back to c0?", cycle[-1]==c0)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
